title: StewardMD Reference-only Disease (knowledge object)
description: Reference-ONLY disease knowledge (kb/reference/*.json). Unlike a diagnostic disease it has NO matching/scoring block and NO treatment file — it exists purely as cited, RAG-retrievable knowledge. Paraphrased from a standard textbook (Harrison for internal medicine; Nelson for paediatrics; Parsons/Kanski for ophthalmology; etc.), page-cited, never verbatim. The knowledge block lives under `harrison` (internal-medicine, legacy key) OR the source-neutral `reference` key — at least one is required, and its inner `source` names the actual textbook. A reference disease may later be PROMOTED to the diagnostic tier by adding a matching block and moving it to kb/diseases/ (Phase-2 work).

id.description: Stable disease key (lower_snake or SCREAMING form, matching the diagnostic-tier convention).

aliases.description: Synonyms / lay terms — used for retrieval.

system.description: Organ system / specialty (free text; mapped to a specialty by the coverage/specialty regex).

specialty.description: Optional explicit specialty tag (e.g. 'Paediatrics', 'Ophthalmology') for new non-IM domains.

referenceOnly.description: MUST be true — this is what distinguishes a reference entry from a diagnostic disease.

harrison.description: Internal-medicine reference knowledge (Harrison). Legacy key; use `reference` for non-IM sources.

reference.description: Source-neutral reference knowledge block (use for Nelson paediatrics, Parsons/Kanski ophthalmology, etc.). Same shape as `harrison`; the inner `source` names the textbook.

knowledgeBlock.description: Paraphrased reference knowledge (page-cited, not verbatim). `source` names the actual textbook/edition.

management.description: AI-drafted, dose-free management pillars (definitive/supportive/monitoring/complications/escalation). Decision-support only; not clinician-verified.
